title: Design System: 골목 리소 전단지 (Alley Riso Flyer)

display.purpose: Hero headline only; one phrase per line, each line an overprinted plate.

headline.purpose: Section titles, overprinted; flood sections may run to clamp(48px, 7vw, 112px).

title.purpose: Price-tag item names and brand marks.

body.purpose: Running text, ledes, notes; word-break keep-all.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, tag titles, visit labels. Never uppercase-tracked; never an eyebrow above a heading.

overprint.name: misregistration
overprint.purpose: The only offset in the system: the pink plate (outline or type duplicate) behind buttons, tags, headlines. Zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion.

overprint.name: riso-a
overprint.value: SVG filter: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.55, numOctaves 3, seed 3; alpha matrix 0 0 0 -3 2.55; composite in
overprint.purpose: Grain voids for type plates, stamps, illustration.

overprint.name: riso-b
overprint.value: SVG filter: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.6, numOctaves 3, seed 11; alpha matrix 0 0 0 -3 2.55; composite in
overprint.purpose: Grain voids for button faces, tags, paper notes (second drum).

overprint.name: riso-flood
overprint.value: SVG filter: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.7, numOctaves 3, seed 5; alpha matrix 0 0 0 -3 2.6; composite in

overprint.name: paper-fibre
overprint.value: fixed body::after, fractalNoise 0.6 tinted, mix-blend-mode multiply, opacity 0.1
overprint.purpose: Faint paper texture across the whole page.

motion.name: register
motion.value: 0.9s ease-out; from translate(24px, -16px) opacity 0 to the misregistration vector; 0.08s stagger per line
motion.purpose: Headline pink plates slide in on load.

motion.name: shudder
motion.purpose: Tag pink plate on hover, once.

motion.name: button-register
motion.value: 0.25s ease-out; pink plate to translate(1px, 1px) on hover; button translate(2px, 2px) on active

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Board to 2 columns; hero stacks type, art, floating tag.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Flood and visit grids to single column.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Board to 1 column, tag tilts removed, bar wraps.

narrative.overview:
The page is a two-color risograph flyer pasted to a telephone pole in a residential alley. Cool grey newsprint carries two spot inks, fluoro pink and federal blue, printed as separate plates that never quite line up. Where the plates overlap, multiply blending makes a deep violet the way real ink does. Every inked surface is grainy: SVG turbulence filters punch voids into the ink so the paper shows through. A third ink, sunflower, floods one whole section and fills parts of the illustration. It is never used for UI chrome or text.

Density is poster-like. Headlines are huge, compressed Korean gothic set edge to edge. Information sits on small paper price tags pinned to the page at slight angles. There are no photographs by default: illustration is made from flat printed shapes (circles, domes, slabs, halftone dot fields), each on its own plate. The signature behavior is misregistration. The pink plate sits offset by a fixed vector (5px, 3px), slides in on load, shudders once on hover, and snaps to perfect register under reduced motion.

This world is a style preset, and its first site is a fictional bakery. The palette, plates, grain, tag, stamp, flood sections, type stack and motion are reusable system. The loaf illustration, the bake-time schedule, the headline copy, the hero art coordinates, and the 3-column board with a 2×2 lead tag belong to 하루치 alone (see Components > Site-specific).
keyCharacteristics: Two spot inks (pink, blue) on cool newsprint, plus one flood ink (sunflower).
Every ink plate carries grain voids, and plates overlap with multiply.
A fixed misregistration vector (5px, 3px) is the system's single offset.
Square corners everywhere except printed circles.
Compressed display gothic, a rounded label face for numbers and actions, and a neutral sans for body text.
Depth comes only from overprint and plate offset, never from light and shadow.

rules.name: The Two Plates Rule
rules.body: Anything inked is either a blue plate or a pink plate (sunflower only as flood or illustration fill). Overlaps are made with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. Violet is never picked as a color. It only ever comes from overprint.

rules.name: The Pink Never Speaks Rule
rules.body: Fluoro pink is for shapes, offsets, hairlines, and underlines. Readable pink text uses only the double-hit pink, and only at stamp size or larger.

rules.name: The Underlay Rule
rules.body: Every grain-filtered surface that carries text sits on a solid underlay color (blue-underlay under blue, newsprint or paper-ink under paper). The voids then reveal a legible ground instead of dropping contrast.

rules.name: The Marker Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every price, clock time, and hour is set in Do Hyeon with tabular figures, never in the body face.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: All three faces run at weight 400. Hierarchy comes from size and face, not from bolding.

rules.name: The Misregistration Rule
rules.body: The only offset in the system is the pink plate shifted by (5px, 3px). It is drawn as an outline or a type duplicate, never as a filled or blurred shadow. Hover pulls it to (1px, 1px) on buttons or shudders it once on tags. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the vector becomes (0, 0) and the plates print in perfect register.

dos: Do print every inked surface through a riso grain filter, and give text-bearing ink a solid underlay (The Underlay Rule).
Do make every overlap with multiply between the pink and blue plates, and let violet appear only there.
Do use the single (5px, 3px) misregistration vector for every offset plate, and zero it under reduced motion.
Do set prices, times, and hours in Do Hyeon with tabular figures.
Do keep containers square, and let roundness live in printed shapes only.
Do divide sections and cells with 1px hairlines (pink on paper, translucent paper-ink inside the blue flood).
donts: Don't set readable text in fluoro pink (#ff3ea5, about 2.6:1 on newsprint), and don't use the double-hit pink below stamp size.
Don't use sunflower for text, borders, or buttons, or place it on the blue flood.
Don't add blurred or light-based `box-shadow` elevation. Depth is only overprint and plate offset.
Don't warm the paper toward cream (#e6e6df was rejected for exactly this).
Don't introduce extra offset values or rotations beyond the tag tilts (-1°, 0.8°, -0.5°, -3° floating) and the stamp (-12°).
Don't bold any face. Everything is weight 400.
